summary: DHCP servers have grown well beyond the base specifications, and one such feature is context-specific configuration, where clients get different settings depending on where they are in the network. This informational memo describes some of these features and explains how they operate.

eli5.summary: A hotel can give guests different Wi-Fi instructions depending on the floor they are on. This describes how address-giving servers can hand out different settings based on where a device plugs in.

questions: how dhcp servers choose options by location
